claim_boundary: This exact theorem proves the conditional algebraic transfer from a D-equivariant retained causal chain contraction to unary and raw arity-two D-Cartan primitives. It does not construct the 26-row Green homotopy, a cyclic arity-two primitive, Hadamard data, residual/BFV rows, a QME solution, or a quantum result.
